what: The shared zero-boot preflight must be RED on the deliberately aliased two-case fixture (the candidate-1 allocation #1 defect) and GREEN on the same plan with per-case locators. This is the negative control the owner directive asks for.

attribution.why_red_is_meaningful: exactly one check (cases.isolation) is red, and it carries exactly the two alias codes; every other check stays green, so the red cannot be collateral damage from a missing host tree or a wrong lane
attribution.defect: cases read-b and search-row3 declare the same locator workspace/lane/outside-restriction.txt and the same guard-fact key, so each judge collects the other's deny fact (candidate-1 allocation #1, 2 rows REFUTED, retried as allocation #4)
